dedupe_keys.name: openlisem hazard integrated multi hazard flood runoff and mass movement model

description: OpenLISEM Hazard is an open-source multi-hazard modelling tool with a semi-structured mass movement model, developed from the OpenLISEM catchment model. Version 2.0 alpha was deposited on 25 May 2020 in the DANS data station by B. van den Bout of the ITC Faculty at the University of Twente, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence. An earlier 2019 package, OpenLisem Multi-Hazard Model and Datasets, holds the model code as used in publications from 2017 to 2019 with datasets and model results for three study areas, with files named for China, Fella, Prado and Sicily, and a documentation PDF, under a DANS licence with some files restricted. The model is available free from DANS. Caveats: it is research software at alpha stage, and the code must be compiled before use. It supports cascading hazard scenarios for roads, settlements and drainage in mountain catchments; a related record is the MYRIAD-EU multi-risk toolkit.
